_meta.purpose: BD-curated per-cited-host action playbooks. Each playbook matches one host_type (and optionally host_subtype) and produces a templated action item the merchant can execute. PR-G wires playbook selection into the merchant audit's action_items list.
_meta.owner: BD team for content (titles, body templates, timelines, leverage); engineering reviews schema only.

schema_per_playbook.applies_when: match criteria: host_type required, host_subtype optional
schema_per_playbook.severity: critical | high | medium | low — applied uniformly across all instances of this playbook

_meta.matching_priority: When multiple playbooks could match a host, the more specific match wins (subtype > type). Unknown hosts (type='unclassified') match the catch-all generic_unclassified playbook.

wholesale_department_store.body_template: {coverage_note} {competitors_phrase}{outreach_hint} Wholesale onboarding is a multi-quarter process; expected timeline: {timeline_low}-{timeline_high} weeks for vendor approval.

wholesale_luxury.body_template: {coverage_note} {competitors_phrase}{outreach_hint} Luxury wholesale requires established brand authority + price point fit; expected timeline: {timeline_low}-{timeline_high} weeks.

wholesale_beauty_retailer.body_template: {coverage_note} {competitors_phrase}{outreach_hint} Beauty specialty retailers run accelerator programs (Sephora Accelerate, Ulta Sparked) for D2C/indie brands as a faster track than direct wholesale.

wholesale_fashion_marketplace.body_template: {coverage_note} {competitors_phrase}{outreach_hint} Fashion marketplace onboarding is faster than department-store wholesale; expected timeline: {timeline_low}-{timeline_high} weeks.

wholesale_mass_market_retailer.body_template: {coverage_note} {outreach_hint} Note: mass-market retailers typically prefer brands at scale; if you're early-stage D2C, prioritize specialty retailers + editorial first.

creator_partnership_video.body_template: {coverage_note} {outreach_hint} For sleepwear/fashion/beauty: focus on mid-tier reviewers (10k-100k subs) who already cover your category. Sponsored reviews land in grounded retrieval within {timeline_low}-{timeline_high} weeks of upload.

creator_partnership_social.body_template: {coverage_note} {outreach_hint} Social-first creators drive social pickup but lower AI-channel grounding weight than YouTube long-form.
